subject: FirstMile onboarding: invoice submission handshake and PO multiline handling
messages:
From: Sung Lee <sung.lee@firstmile.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmeinc.com
Date: Mon, 31 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — invoicing process question

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the onboarding call earlier. Quick follow-up from our accounting team: for our first invoice (PO 12345), do you prefer we upload the invoice to your portal or email PDFs to accounts@redwood.com?

A couple of specifics they asked for:
- If email is allowed, what exact subject line or token do you require so the invoice auto-acknowledges?
- Does Redwood accept multiple PO numbers on a single invoice line or must each PO be on a separate invoice?
- Any mandatory fields you need for VAT / tax handling for US customers?

We can produce whichever format is easiest for you — just want to avoid a manual queue on day one.

Thanks,
Sung Lee
Director of Finance
FirstMile Logistics
attachments: PO-12345.pdf (PDF, 128KB)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Sung Lee <sung.lee@firstmile.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Jul 2028 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoicing process question

Thanks Sung — great questions. Short answer: portal-first, email backstop with a strict subject token. Details below and a small sample CSV attached.

Portal (preferred):
- If you can onboard to our portal, the invoice will be accepted, validated, and acked automatically (T+0 to T+1).
- Portal supports multi-PO invoices (one invoice record referencing multiple PO IDs).

Email fallback (when portal not usable):
- Send to accounts@redwood.com with subject: INVOICE|FIRSTMILE|PO=12345 (example). The token must start with INVOICE| and include your vendor short-name.
- Attach the PDF invoice AND a CSV that contains line-level metadata. We use the CSV for automated parsing and PO matching.

Minimal CSV columns we require (sample attached as firstmile_invoice_sample_rows.csv):
vendor_name, invoice_number, invoice_date, po_number, line_description, qty, unit_price, currency, tax_rate, tax_amount, total_amount

On multi-POs: include multiple rows with the same invoice_number and different po_number values. We reconcile line-level totals to the PDF.

VAT / tax: for US-based payments you can set tax_rate as 0 if non-taxable; include any withholding fields in an extra column named withholding_amount if needed.

If you'd like, Monica (cc'd) can share the exact subject token regex and an example ack file we emit. Marissa will be your billing contact for any manual exceptions.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0198
redwood.com
attachments: firstmile_invoice_sample_rows.csv

From: Sung Lee <sung.lee@firstmile.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, procurement@acmeinc.com
Date: Tue, 01 Aug 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoicing process question

Thanks Sean — helpful. Two follow-ups: 

1) If a single invoice references 3 POs (two from Acme, one internal), do you require the POs to be issued to the same legal entity? The Acme procurement team (cc'd) sometimes routes POs to different billed entities.
2) In the CSV, can line-level attachments be referenced (e.g., serialized part photos) or do those need separate emails?

If we stick to the CSV approach we can script exports from our ERP. Want to confirm edge rules before we send the first file.

Best,
Sung

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sung Lee <sung.lee@firstmile.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Aug 2028 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoicing process question

Hi Sung — Monica from Onboarding here. Quick answers and a couple of constraints to avoid delays: 

1) Legal entity / PO mapping
- We require that each invoice maps to a single paying entity (our AP system can't split a single invoice across legal entities). If your three POs map to more than one Redwood legal entity, please issue separate invoices per billed entity. It is fine to reference multiple POs on a single invoice as long as the billed entity is the same.

2) Line-level attachments
- The CSV can include an attachments column with file names (e.g., photo_01.jpg). However, those files must be attached to the email ZIP alongside the PDF/CSV. Our ingestion will look up attachments by filename. If files are large, upload them to a shared Drive link and reference that link in the CSV.

3) Acknowledgement and idempotency
- After ingestion we send an ack file to the submitting address (example attached as redwood_ack_example.txt). If you re-send the same invoice_number + invoice_date the system will detect duplicates and return status DUPLICATE. Use a corrected invoice_number if you need to reissue.

4) Manual exception SLA
- If a submission fails validation and needs manual review, expect up to 3 business days for resolution. For urgent first invoices we can expedite; tag the email subject with [EXPEDITE] and copy Vanessa.

I'll attach the subject token regex and a small checklist. Ping me if you'd like a short shared screen to run a practice submission.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Vendor Onboarding Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_ack_example.txt

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sung Lee <sung.lee@firstmile.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Aug 2028 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoicing process question

Hi all — ops note from our billing queue: 

- If you must email the first invoice, please include PO-12345.pdf + the CSV + any line-level files in a single ZIP named FIRSTMILE_PO12345.zip. That prevents the parser from dropping attachments.
- For invoices that ultimately require manual stamping (rare), Marissa will reach out for any clarifying docs and will also confirm the payment entity.
- If Acme requires us to apply different tax handling on their side, we will create a crosswalk but that will push you into manual processing. Ideally ensure POs for the same invoice point to the same billed entity to keep it automated.

Vanessa
Head of Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
Vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

On a process note: once we receive the first auto-ack, we recommend scheduling weekly batched submissions until feeds are validated. That keeps exceptions low.
